services.name: Reef Fishing
services.desc: When you book a private charter, the 56-foot Gulfstream IV runs for your group and nobody else - no shared seats, no strangers on the rail. Five hours of fishing, up to 45 guests, and your pick of an 8 AM, 9 AM or 10 AM departure. Families, work groups, bachelor parties and birthdays all fit comfortably - see how it compares to our shared party boat. One flat rate for the whole boat - not a per-seat price. Both tiers are the same 5-hour trip on the Gulfstream IV with the same inclusions. Looking to get out on the water with your own crew? Our Private Charters on the Gulfstream IV are the way to do it.
